items.question: What sign must the practitioner observe after seven invocations when looking at the cakrarāja?
items.inference: The practitioner should look for a sign facing him, whether it appears on both sides or on one side.
uncertainties: the exact ritual referent of cakrarāja is not specified by this verse
the precise meaning of the sign remains context-dependent
items.plain_english: After seven invocations, the steady-minded practitioner should look at the cakrarāja; the sign facing the practitioner may appear on both sides or on one side.
